name: Sarabetsu (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Sarabetsu village emblem in white, yellow and green: a white trefoil-shaped shield edged yellow bearing the characters 更別 and a green clover.
history: Municipal flag of Sarabetsu, a village in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted in 1947.

features.role: Sarabetsu village emblem — a white trefoil-shaped shield edged yellow bearing the characters 更別 and a green clover
